text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Okay, frog. This is your room from now
on!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
This frog is going to be staying in my
office for a
short while. The reason
being...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
All animals of the academy are my
potential
familiars! If they get hurt, I
need to look after
them!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
However, pets are not allowed in the
dorms.
We've been discussing what we
should do.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I'm naming you Slurpy! Since I'll be
taking care of
you, you might as well
have a name!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I brought you some food, Slurpy! You
better eat
every bite, okay?!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
C'mon! Look at what a mess you've
made!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
No, no, no, nooo! I don't wanna do that!
I'm not
in the mood today!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Why you... Here's your punishment!
Slurpy, spring
into action!
choice_data_list: でも、もうメニュー組んでるから……

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, success! You should've seen the
look on
your face, Familiar!
Nice job,
Slurpy!

text_block_list.name: Slurpy
text_block_list.text: Ribbit, ribbit. ♪

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna make you into... such a great fami...liar... Zzz... Zzz...

text_block_list.name: Slurpy
text_block_list.text: Ribbit...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Sweep Tosho spends time with the frog
whenever
she has the chance. Thanks to
that, Slurpy's injury
has been healing
quite nicely.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Hop, hop, hop!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Nice job, Slurpy! You're hopping like a
pro!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
That is fantastic. It looks like he can go
back to
his friends now!
choice_data_list: ケガの痕も目立たないしな
ケガの痕も目立たないしね

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Oh...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: N-no! No way!
choice_data_list: この子の家族も待ってるかもな
この子の家族も待ってるかもね

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Um... I mean... It still looks like his leg is
in pain,
don't you think?! He isn't better
yet! He can't go!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: I said no! He can't go until I say so!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Ribbit! I found a bunch of worms in the
rain!
They're your favorite, right? Here!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: (Ribbit, ribbit, ribbit...)

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: ...What's that?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
...Hmph! Whatever! Anyway, Slurpy,
aren't you
hungry? Eat your favorite
food!
choice_data_list: 外でカエルが鳴いているみたいだ
外でカエルが鳴いているみたい

text_block_list.name: Slurpy
text_block_list.text: Ribbit... Ribbit, ribbit.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Wait! What are you doing?!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
You're my familiar! There's nothing you
need
outside!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
It looks like he can go back to his
friends now!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I'm sure his family is waiting for him.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I'm sure his family is waiting for him.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
...Do you want to see your friends and
family?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Sweep Tosho grabs the cage somewhat
roughly
and releases the frog outside
right away.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Stupid Slurpy...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hmph! Anyone so weak as to sit around
missing
their family would never make it
as my familiar!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I have no problem living away from my
family in a
dorm! 'Cause I'm a grown-up!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
And then there's Slurpy! Just a little
baby that
misses his family!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
...Come back when you're old enough to
be
without Mommy and Daddy!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Just then, we hear frogs start croaking
outside as
if responding to her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Just then, we hear frogs start croaking
outside as
if responding to her.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
choice_data_list: あの子の分まで、スイープの力になるよ

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hmph... I'm holding you to that! You
better work
your butt off!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
You need to stay close and set a good
example
for the other familiars!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
What're you acting all high and mighty
for?!
You've got a long way to go
yourself!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
You better do your best to shape up
into a
worthy familiar by the time Slurpy
gets back!
